queries:
WITH g AS (
  SELECT o.lunarstage AS ls, AVG(t.bandusagepct) AS a, COUNT(*) AS c
  FROM telescopes t
  JOIN observatories o ON t.observstation = o.observstation
  GROUP BY o.lunarstage
),
m AS (
  SELECT AVG(a) AS mu FROM g
),
k AS (
  SELECT g.a AS a, g.c AS c, m.mu AS mu
  FROM g, m
  WHERE g.a > m.mu
)
SELECT AVG(a) AS avg_of_averages, SUM(c) AS total_count, AVG(a - mu) AS avg_excess
FROM k;
WITH phase AS (
  SELECT o.lunarstage AS stage,
         AVG(t.bandusagepct) AS avg_bw,
         COUNT(t.bandusagepct) AS cnt
  FROM telescopes t
  JOIN observatories o ON t.observstation = o.observstation
  GROUP BY o.lunarstage
  HAVING COUNT(t.bandusagepct) > 0
),
m AS (
  SELECT AVG(avg_bw) AS mean_avg FROM phase
)
SELECT AVG(p.avg_bw) AS avg_of_avgs,
       SUM(p.cnt) AS total_count,
       AVG(p.avg_bw - m.mean_avg) AS avg_excess
FROM phase p, m
WHERE p.avg_bw > m.mean_avg;
WITH phase AS (
  SELECT o.lunarstage AS lunarstage,
         AVG(t.bandusagepct) AS avg_bw,
         COUNT(DISTINCT t.telescregistry) AS cnt
  FROM telescopes t
  JOIN observatories o ON t.observstation = o.observstation
  GROUP BY o.lunarstage
),
m AS (
  SELECT AVG(avg_bw) AS mean_avg FROM phase
)
SELECT AVG(p.avg_bw) AS avg_of_avgs,
       SUM(p.cnt) AS total_count,
       AVG(p.avg_bw - m.mean_avg) AS avg_excess
FROM phase p, m
WHERE p.avg_bw > m.mean_avg;
WITH joined AS (
  SELECT o.lunarstage AS lunarstage, t.bandusagepct AS bandusagepct
  FROM telescopes t
  JOIN observatories o ON t.observstation = o.observstation
),
phase AS (
  SELECT lunarstage, AVG(bandusagepct) AS avg_bw, COUNT(*) AS cnt
  FROM joined
  GROUP BY lunarstage
),
overall AS (
  SELECT AVG(bandusagepct) AS mean_bw FROM joined
)
SELECT
  AVG(p.avg_bw) AS avg_of_phase_averages,
  SUM(p.cnt) AS total_count,
  AVG(p.avg_bw - ov.mean_bw) AS avg_excess
FROM phase p
CROSS JOIN overall ov
WHERE p.avg_bw > ov.mean_bw;
